critique.evidence: Strong cyber-editorial art direction: disciplined cyan/red palette, crisp dark panels, clear ALLOW/BLOCK contrast, consistent monospaced labels, and a convincing desktop hierarchy. However, tablet and especially mobile become excessively tall and visually dense; numerous labels, annotations, and header links are very small/low-emphasis. The mobile header exposes only a clipped horizontal slice of navigation and drops the brand text, while the mobile results card has cramped wrapping and weak breathing room. These responsive compromises keep it below genuinely demo-ready polish.
critique.fix: Improve the narrow-screen composition: enlarge secondary text, reduce tracking, add spacing around dense result content, and consolidate or progressively disclose controls/results to shorten the page. Replace the clipped header rail with an explicit compact navigation pattern that preserves the brand and current-section context.
